implementation.sharedMotion: One active tab plate; popup opacity/individual scale; folds use Radix height; local section tones; no new global observers or CSS modules.
implementation.dashboard: Raised fact plates, original vector filaments, fading SVG mask; decoration follows local pointer without moving text.
implementation.knowledge: Actual parent hierarchy, roving keyboard focus, reveal active ancestors, page tabs and document/graph/split; small neutral graph nodes, optional groups and semantics, single-click opening, canceled/dragged gestures do not open. Fixed canvas dimensions prevent ResizeObserver feedback.
implementation.library: Shared local fabric, result-pane-driven columns, preview and existing filters; stale search results invalidated. Mobile preview opens only on explicit card selection and returns focus when closed.
implementation.boundaries: No schema, migration, flag, authorization, RPG calculation or service payload changes.

tests.scope: Vitest including real tree keyboard/actions and graph click/drag/cancel test double.

finalRerun.scope: Shared dialogs, navigation, focus/hand-off, hover reflection and reduced-motion after final source changes.

nexus.latestLibraryGrid: Passed in all four widths with cards >=200px, explicit mobile preview and focus return; default, graph, tree and combined reading verified with 120 fixture pages.

sheet.scope: Editable, read-only, loading and error/retry; folds, controls/limits, inventory, autosave/retry, dialogs/focus and reflection; all backend requests intercepted.

localEvidence.quality: npm run check passed on the final implementation: style/project gates, lint, typecheck, 128 suites/561 tests and production build.

limitations: Fixtures intercept backend reads/writes and realtime; they do not certify real-account authorization or RLS.
Not a complete Obsidian clone: no vault, plugins or arbitrary pane docking.
CSS/vector glass and fabric, not physical refraction or cloth simulation.
Integration, CI and public production SHA remain separate from local evidence.
